description: Maintenance or read-only window of the whole platform, with a scheduled start and end and the notice to the users.

state.title: Current state
state.description: What applies right now. A change reaches every server within 5 seconds.
state.label: State
state.active: In progress, with no end time

form.title: Maintenance window
form.description: Turn it on now or schedule the start and end. Times are in Brasília time.
form.enabled: Turn the window on (now or at the scheduled start)
form.endsAtHint: Empty: lasts until someone ends it.
form.messagesHint: Optional, up to 500 characters per language. Without text in a language, the Portuguese one is used; without any, only the default notice.
form.readOnly: Only platform owner and operations change the maintenance.

effects.title: What each mode does
effects.maintenance: Full maintenance: /app and /admin show the maintenance page, and the workspace API and MCP answer 503 with Retry-After.
effects.readOnly: Read-only: screens open, but every write in /app and /admin is refused with a notice, and the API refuses writes with 503.
effects.jobs: In both modes jobs wait in the queue and run when the window ends; incoming webhooks keep being stored.
effects.agents: AI agents: the channels receive and store the messages, and the GUIDS answer when the window ends.
effects.notice: Up to 24 hours before the start, a strip warns every user.

errors.closed: The system is under maintenance. Try again later.
errors.readOnly: The system is read-only during maintenance. No change was saved.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
errors.endInPast: The end must be in the future.
errors.messageTooLong: Each message takes up to 500 characters.

strip.readOnly: Read-only: changes are suspended during maintenance.
strip.readOnlyUntil: Read-only until {end}: changes are suspended during maintenance.
strip.maintenance: Maintenance in progress: workspaces and the partner console are closed.
strip.maintenanceUntil: Maintenance in progress until {end}: workspaces and the partner console are closed.

page.title: We are under maintenance
page.description: The dashboard will be back soon. No data was lost, and the messages received will be answered when it is back.
page.over: There is no maintenance in progress.

api.closed: GUIDU is under maintenance. Try again later.
api.readOnly: GUIDU is read-only during maintenance. Reads work; writes are refused.
